title.narrative: Programme-Funded Delivery, Management and Advisory Support

description.narrative:
This project covers the costs of Programme-Funded Post (PFP) positions supporting delivery of the Science & Technology Accelerator - Systems (STA-S) programme. The roles provide dedicated capacity for programme management, technical coordination, monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL), and advisory support across the programme's three components.
PFPs support effective oversight and coordination of complex, multi-country system-strengthening interventions delivered through strategic partners and regional teams. This includes portfolio management, progress and financial monitoring, risk management, results tracking, and consolidation of learning across components and geographies. The roles also support engagement with delivery partners and internal stakeholders to ensure coherence with the programme's Theory of Change, Logframe, and Value for Money framework.
By strengthening in-house programme management and learning capability, this project enables the programme to operate as an integrated platform programme, deliver at scale, adapt to emerging priorities, and ensure robust governance, compliance and accountability in line with FCDO Programme Operating Framework (PrOF) requirements.
